_note: ucum-lhc 8.0.1: UCUM codes (case-sensitive). Spellings checked against the installed library by converting each code to base units and comparing the factor with pint's for the same Dimvexa name; a code is mapped only where UCUM defines a unit with that meaning. Not mapped because UCUM has no such unit: torr, hp_metric, lbmol, yr_common, scf, Nm3, psig, barg, acre_int (UCUM has only the British and US survey acres), and bare ambiguous names. UCUM has no temperature-difference units: delta_K and delta_degC map to K, delta_degF and delta_degR to [degR] (the unit size is the same). Correct via the 'Runner review' issue template.
